meta.title: See You
meta.description: People often use the phrase "see you later" when leaving, but machines could never understand the reason why.

units.rawText: Training Course, Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: Training Course, Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: Training Course, Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: The Intermediate Sanctifier Faith carefully studies the hostile agents simulated from operands around her, methodically smashing them while advancing toward the glowing waypoints.
units.displayText: The Intermediate Sanctifier Faith carefully studies the hostile agents simulated from operands around her, methodically smashing them while advancing toward the glowing waypoints.

spans.text: The Intermediate Sanctifier Faith carefully studies the hostile agents simulated from operands around her, methodically smashing them while advancing toward the glowing waypoints.

units.rawText: [Objective completion 70%... 80%...]
units.displayText: [Objective completion 70%... 80%...]

spans.text: [Objective completion 70%... 80%...]

units.rawText: [New unit has arrived at the training course.]
units.displayText: [New unit has arrived at the training course.]

spans.text: [New unit has arrived at the training course.]

units.rawText: [Verifying identity: Intermediate Sanctifier, <color=orange>Wisdom</color>.]
units.displayText: [Verifying identity: Intermediate Sanctifier, Wisdom.]

spans.text: [Verifying identity: Intermediate Sanctifier,
Wisdom

units.rawText: [Initiating training mode.]
units.displayText: [Initiating training mode.]

spans.text: [Initiating training mode.]

units.rawText: Wisdom, it's you. Are you here to train as well?
units.displayText: Wisdom, it's you. Are you here to train as well?

spans.text: Wisdom, it's you. Are you here to train as well?

units.rawText: No, don't activate training mode! Access mode, <size=48>ACCESS</size>!
units.displayText: No, don't activate training mode! Access mode, ACCESS!

spans.text: No, don't activate training mode! Access mode,
ACCESS

units.rawText: [Initiating access mode.]
units.displayText: [Initiating access mode.]

spans.text: [Initiating access mode.]

units.rawText: The simulated enemies surrounding them all vanish at once.
units.displayText: The simulated enemies surrounding them all vanish at once.

spans.text: The simulated enemies surrounding them all vanish at once.

units.rawText: ...What are you trying to do?
units.displayText: ...What are you trying to do?

spans.text: ...What are you trying to do?

units.rawText: Wisdom doesn't answer her question. Instead, she nimbly ducks behind Faith and firmly grabs her shoulders.
units.displayText: Wisdom doesn't answer her question. Instead, she nimbly ducks behind Faith and firmly grabs her shoulders.

spans.text: Wisdom doesn't answer her question. Instead, she nimbly ducks behind Faith and firmly grabs her shoulders.

units.rawText: I'll explain later, just save me for now! Someone annoying is coming!
units.displayText: I'll explain later, just save me for now! Someone annoying is coming!

spans.text: I'll explain later, just save me for now! Someone annoying is coming!

units.rawText: We are friends. Helping you is my duty.
units.displayText: We are friends. Helping you is my duty.

spans.text: We are friends. Helping you is my duty.

units.rawText: But what kind of person is chasing you?
units.displayText: But what kind of person is chasing you?

spans.text: But what kind of person is chasing you?

units.rawText: Surely the Reverse Tower is absolutely safe with Lord Eosphorus in residence...
units.displayText: Surely the Reverse Tower is absolutely safe with Lord Eosphorus in residence...

spans.text: Surely the Reverse Tower is absolutely safe with Lord Eosphorus in residence...

units.rawText: [Verifying identity: Intermediate Sanctifier, <color=orange>Love</color>.]
units.displayText: [Verifying identity: Intermediate Sanctifier, Love.]

spans.text: [Verifying identity: Intermediate Sanctifier,
Love

units.rawText: <size=40>It's not safe anymore, is it!?</size>
units.displayText: It's not safe anymore, is it!?

spans.text: It's not safe anymore, is it!?

units.rawText: Wisdom, you have nowhere else to run, so you might as well stop here!
units.displayText: Wisdom, you have nowhere else to run, so you might as well stop here!

spans.text: Wisdom, you have nowhere else to run, so you might as well stop here!

units.rawText: ...What's the matter, Love?
units.displayText: ...What's the matter, Love?

spans.text: ...What's the matter, Love?

units.rawText: Although she doesn't know what's going on, Faith still puts herself in between Love and Wisdom and tries to smooth things out.
units.displayText: Although she doesn't know what's going on, Faith still puts herself in between Love and Wisdom and tries to smooth things out.

spans.text: Although she doesn't know what's going on, Faith still puts herself in between Love and Wisdom and tries to smooth things out.

units.rawText: With Faith in her way, Love has no choice but to stop. Her usually serene features betray a hint of irritation.
units.displayText: With Faith in her way, Love has no choice but to stop. Her usually serene features betray a hint of irritation.

spans.text: With Faith in her way, Love has no choice but to stop. Her usually serene features betray a hint of irritation.

units.rawText: Wisdom called the Lesser Sanctifiers "tin cans" and mistreated my subordinate "Refactor." I want her to take her words back right now!
units.displayText: Wisdom called the Lesser Sanctifiers "tin cans" and mistreated my subordinate "Refactor." I want her to take her words back right now!

spans.text: Wisdom called the Lesser Sanctifiers "tin cans" and mistreated my subordinate "Refactor." I want her to take her words back right now!

units.rawText: I'm not wrong though. The Lessers hardly have any intelligence, which makes them tin cans...
units.displayText: I'm not wrong though. The Lessers hardly have any intelligence, which makes them tin cans...

spans.text: I'm not wrong though. The Lessers hardly have any intelligence, which makes them tin cans...

units.rawText: If they were smarter, our command efficiency would be much higher!
units.displayText: If they were smarter, our command efficiency would be much higher!

spans.text: If they were smarter, our command efficiency would be much higher!

units.rawText: You heard it too, Faith! She's insulting the Lesser Sanctifiers who go into battle with us!
units.displayText: You heard it too, Faith! She's insulting the Lesser Sanctifiers who go into battle with us!

spans.text: You heard it too, Faith! She's insulting the Lesser Sanctifiers who go into battle with us!

units.rawText: Faith's in the middle of recovery training after being reset. She won't be bothered by such things!
units.displayText: Faith's in the middle of recovery training after being reset. She won't be bothered by such things!

spans.text: Faith's in the middle of recovery training after being reset. She won't be bothered by such things!

units.rawText: I know Faith's character. She'll help me convince you.
units.displayText: I know Faith's character. She'll help me convince you.

spans.text: I know Faith's character. She'll help me convince you.

units.rawText: What joins us is belief, and what keeps our formation unbreakable is the spirit of friendship.
units.displayText: What joins us is belief, and what keeps our formation unbreakable is the spirit of friendship.

spans.text: What joins us is belief, and what keeps our formation unbreakable is the spirit of friendship.

units.rawText: That's a pretty speech, but the Lessers can't even tell us Intermediates apart. What does that make them if not tin cans?
units.displayText: That's a pretty speech, but the Lessers can't even tell us Intermediates apart. What does that make them if not tin cans?

spans.text: That's a pretty speech, but the Lessers can't even tell us Intermediates apart. What does that make them if not tin cans?

units.rawText: You're with me, right, Faith?
units.displayText: You're with me, right, Faith?

spans.text: You're with me, right, Faith?

units.rawText: As Wisdom looks at the silent Faith, her confident smile slowly turns stiff.
units.displayText: As Wisdom looks at the silent Faith, her confident smile slowly turns stiff.

spans.text: As Wisdom looks at the silent Faith, her confident smile slowly turns stiff.

units.rawText: ...Right?
units.displayText: ...Right?

spans.text: ...Right?

units.rawText: Come on, Faith, haven't I always backed you up?
units.displayText: Come on, Faith, haven't I always backed you up?

spans.text: Come on, Faith, haven't I always backed you up?

units.rawText: I... do not quite understand what you're arguing about. This does not seem to have anything to do with the Sanctifiers' purpose.
units.displayText: I... do not quite understand what you're arguing about. This does not seem to have anything to do with the Sanctifiers' purpose.

spans.text: I... do not quite understand what you're arguing about. This does not seem to have anything to do with the Sanctifiers' purpose.

units.rawText: But there is one thing which I am certain—we are friends who stick together through thick and thin.
units.displayText: But there is one thing which I am certain—we are friends who stick together through thick and thin.

spans.text: But there is one thing which I am certain—we are friends who stick together through thick and thin.

units.rawText: Indeed, we are. But she bullied the Refactors under my command and then tried to borrow them.
units.displayText: Indeed, we are. But she bullied the Refactors under my command and then tried to borrow them.

spans.text: Indeed, we are. But she bullied the Refactors under my command and then tried to borrow them.

units.rawText: If she doesn't admit her mistakes, I can tell my Refactors will suffer very heavy casualties...
units.displayText: If she doesn't admit her mistakes, I can tell my Refactors will suffer very heavy casualties...

spans.text: If she doesn't admit her mistakes, I can tell my Refactors will suffer very heavy casualties...

units.rawText: I told you, it wasn't bullying... I was just training them...
units.displayText: I told you, it wasn't bullying... I was just training them...

spans.text: I told you, it wasn't bullying... I was just training them...

units.rawText: Wisdom, danger is one thing, but the operand expenditures for that kind of healing are far over-budget!
units.displayText: Wisdom, danger is one thing, but the operand expenditures for that kind of healing are far over-budget!

spans.text: Wisdom, danger is one thing, but the operand expenditures for that kind of healing are far over-budget!

units.rawText: It's nothing to the Reverse Tower, it's fine.
units.displayText: It's nothing to the Reverse Tower, it's fine.

spans.text: It's nothing to the Reverse Tower, it's fine.

units.rawText: It's better to get hurt in training than to die on the battlefield, right? I'm pretty sure Lord Eosphorus would approve of this!
units.displayText: It's better to get hurt in training than to die on the battlefield, right? I'm pretty sure Lord Eosphorus would approve of this!

spans.text: It's better to get hurt in training than to die on the battlefield, right? I'm pretty sure Lord Eosphorus would approve of this!

units.rawText: You can only talk so big because you're not a healer!
units.displayText: You can only talk so big because you're not a healer!

spans.text: You can only talk so big because you're not a healer!

units.rawText: I don't want to see my friends get hurt, no matter the circumstances...
units.displayText: I don't want to see my friends get hurt, no matter the circumstances...

spans.text: I don't want to see my friends get hurt, no matter the circumstances...

units.rawText: That's why I said they're just tin cans, no need to get so bent out of shape about it.
units.displayText: That's why I said they're just tin cans, no need to get so bent out of shape about it.

spans.text: That's why I said they're just tin cans, no need to get so bent out of shape about it.

units.rawText: If they were smarter, I wouldn't have to do this!
units.displayText: If they were smarter, I wouldn't have to do this!

spans.text: If they were smarter, I wouldn't have to do this!

units.rawText: You called them tin cans again! If you keep doing that, I'll report you to the Tribunal!
units.displayText: You called them tin cans again! If you keep doing that, I'll report you to the Tribunal!

spans.text: You called them tin cans again! If you keep doing that, I'll report you to the Tribunal!

units.rawText: The... the Tribunal!?
units.displayText: The... the Tribunal!?

spans.text: The... the Tribunal!?

units.rawText: Humph, you nearly got me there. Our seniors from the Tribunal, <color=orange>Crime</color> and <color=orange>Punishment</color>, are running around chasing down Entropized Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Humph, you nearly got me there. Our seniors from the Tribunal, Crime and Punishment, are running around chasing down Entropized Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Humph, you nearly got me there. Our seniors from the Tribunal,
Crime
and
Punishment
, are running around chasing down Entropized Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: (Scowls)
units.displayText: Scowls

spans.text: Scowls

units.rawText: Love looks to Faith for support, and Faith looks back at them a bit helplessly.
units.displayText: Love looks to Faith for support, and Faith looks back at them a bit helplessly.

spans.text: Love looks to Faith for support, and Faith looks back at them a bit helplessly.

units.rawText: (Sighs) Alright, Love, I don't have much time left and I don't have time to argue.
units.displayText: (Sighs) Alright, Love, I don't have much time left and I don't have time to argue.

spans.text: (Sighs) Alright, Love, I don't have much time left and I don't have time to argue.

units.rawText: I'm heading over to the Pierides Sector on a mission, to suppress a small-scale Entropy outbreak.
units.displayText: I'm heading over to the Pierides Sector on a mission, to suppress a small-scale Entropy outbreak.

spans.text: I'm heading over to the Pierides Sector on a mission, to suppress a small-scale Entropy outbreak.

units.rawText: That's why I'm trying to make last-minute preparations to become more battle-ready.
units.displayText: That's why I'm trying to make last-minute preparations to become more battle-ready.

spans.text: That's why I'm trying to make last-minute preparations to become more battle-ready.

units.rawText: In that case... Promise me that you'll take good care of them, just like you do me and Faith.
units.displayText: In that case... Promise me that you'll take good care of them, just like you do me and Faith.

spans.text: In that case... Promise me that you'll take good care of them, just like you do me and Faith.

units.rawText: Alright, alright, I promise I'll do my best to use them properly...
units.displayText: Alright, alright, I promise I'll do my best to use them properly...

spans.text: Alright, alright, I promise I'll do my best to use them properly...

units.rawText: After Wisdom makes her promise, Love nods.
units.displayText: After Wisdom makes her promise, Love nods.

spans.text: After Wisdom makes her promise, Love nods.

units.rawText: With the supreme laws of the Reverse Babylon Tower as my witness, I accept your promise.
units.displayText: With the supreme laws of the Reverse Babylon Tower as my witness, I accept your promise.

spans.text: With the supreme laws of the Reverse Babylon Tower as my witness, I accept your promise.

units.rawText: The tension in the air finally dissolves.
units.displayText: The tension in the air finally dissolves.

spans.text: The tension in the air finally dissolves.

units.rawText: Wisdom walks out from behind Faith and sits down on the floor of the training course. She raises her gun and takes aim at a distant target.
units.displayText: Wisdom walks out from behind Faith and sits down on the floor of the training course. She raises her gun and takes aim at a distant target.

spans.text: Wisdom walks out from behind Faith and sits down on the floor of the training course. She raises her gun and takes aim at a distant target.

units.rawText: Hold on, Wisdom.
units.displayText: Hold on, Wisdom.

spans.text: Hold on, Wisdom.

units.rawText: Earlier, you mentioned the Entropics, our mortal enemies... Have they managed to infiltrate as far as the Pierides Sector?
units.displayText: Earlier, you mentioned the Entropics, our mortal enemies... Have they managed to infiltrate as far as the Pierides Sector?

spans.text: Earlier, you mentioned the Entropics, our mortal enemies... Have they managed to infiltrate as far as the Pierides Sector?

units.rawText: Was I reset in Rossum because I could not defeat the Entropics?
units.displayText: Was I reset in Rossum because I could not defeat the Entropics?

spans.text: Was I reset in Rossum because I could not defeat the Entropics?

units.rawText: Wisdom exchanges a glance with Love.
units.displayText: Wisdom exchanges a glance with Love.

spans.text: Wisdom exchanges a glance with Love.

units.rawText: Let me explain.
units.displayText: Let me explain.

spans.text: Let me explain.

units.rawText: Faith, you were reset because you killed <color=orange>Turing</color>, the administrator of the Rossum Sector.
units.displayText: Faith, you were reset because you killed Turing, the administrator of the Rossum Sector.

spans.text: Faith, you were reset because you killed
Turing
, the administrator of the Rossum Sector.

units.rawText: After that, you were punished by being stripped of your privileges.
units.displayText: After that, you were punished by being stripped of your privileges.

spans.text: After that, you were punished by being stripped of your privileges.

units.rawText: A bunch of Irregular Agents ambushed you and you were sent back to the Pantheon to be reset.
units.displayText: A bunch of Irregular Agents ambushed you and you were sent back to the Pantheon to be reset.

spans.text: A bunch of Irregular Agents ambushed you and you were sent back to the Pantheon to be reset.

units.rawText: Why would I kill the administrator of the Rossum Sector?
units.displayText: Why would I kill the administrator of the Rossum Sector?

spans.text: Why would I kill the administrator of the Rossum Sector?

units.rawText: Well... Soon after that, the Rossum Sector was locked down by a new kind of firewall, so we couldn't obtain more detailed records.
units.displayText: Well... Soon after that, the Rossum Sector was locked down by a new kind of firewall, so we couldn't obtain more detailed records.

spans.text: Well... Soon after that, the Rossum Sector was locked down by a new kind of firewall, so we couldn't obtain more detailed records.

units.rawText: Also, you've always handled affairs in Rossum all by yourself, so we don't know too much either...
units.displayText: Also, you've always handled affairs in Rossum all by yourself, so we don't know too much either...

spans.text: Also, you've always handled affairs in Rossum all by yourself, so we don't know too much either...

units.rawText: I see. No wonder I was barred from entering the Rossum Sector.
units.displayText: I see. No wonder I was barred from entering the Rossum Sector.

spans.text: I see. No wonder I was barred from entering the Rossum Sector.

units.rawText: Love looks startled, and Wisdom also jumps up, clutching her gun.
units.displayText: Love looks startled, and Wisdom also jumps up, clutching her gun.

spans.text: Love looks startled, and Wisdom also jumps up, clutching her gun.

units.rawText: You went to the Rossum Sector? How is it? Is it still okay?
units.displayText: You went to the Rossum Sector? How is it? Is it still okay?

spans.text: You went to the Rossum Sector? How is it? Is it still okay?

units.rawText: Has it been taken over by Irregular Agents and turned into something like the border battlefront?
units.displayText: Has it been taken over by Irregular Agents and turned into something like the border battlefront?

spans.text: Has it been taken over by Irregular Agents and turned into something like the border battlefront?

units.rawText: No, it seemed very peaceful. Everything was operating normally.
units.displayText: No, it seemed very peaceful. Everything was operating normally.

spans.text: No, it seemed very peaceful. Everything was operating normally.

units.rawText: I requested access, but I was denied.
units.displayText: I requested access, but I was denied.

spans.text: I requested access, but I was denied.

units.rawText: Was it Turing?
units.displayText: Was it Turing?

spans.text: Was it Turing?

units.rawText: No, it was an agent with the designation <color=orange>Hannah</color>. I do not understand the reason for it.
units.displayText: No, it was an agent with the designation Hannah. I do not understand the reason for it.

spans.text: No, it was an agent with the designation
Hannah
. I do not understand the reason for it.

units.rawText: We are supposed to be the Sanctifiers, protectors of Magrasea, but why...
units.displayText: We are supposed to be the Sanctifiers, protectors of Magrasea, but why...

spans.text: We are supposed to be the Sanctifiers, protectors of Magrasea, but why...

units.rawText: These agents are unfathomable.
units.displayText: These agents are unfathomable.

spans.text: These agents are unfathomable.

units.rawText: I mean, they're agents, so why are they being so unreasonable?
units.displayText: I mean, they're agents, so why are they being so unreasonable?

spans.text: I mean, they're agents, so why are they being so unreasonable?

units.rawText: I don't understand either... Perhaps we weren't being friendly enough when handling the Rossum incident.
units.displayText: I don't understand either... Perhaps we weren't being friendly enough when handling the Rossum incident.

spans.text: I don't understand either... Perhaps we weren't being friendly enough when handling the Rossum incident.

units.rawText: Ever since Lord Hesperus came to power, we've given many sectors the impression that we're violent and unreasonable.
units.displayText: Ever since Lord Hesperus came to power, we've given many sectors the impression that we're violent and unreasonable.

spans.text: Ever since Lord Hesperus came to power, we've given many sectors the impression that we're violent and unreasonable.

units.rawText: So we have to be friendly and loving to the people that we protect...?
units.displayText: So we have to be friendly and loving to the people that we protect...?

spans.text: So we have to be friendly and loving to the people that we protect...?

units.rawText: Yes, of course. That's in line with Lord Eosphorus' ideals, isn't it?
units.displayText: Yes, of course. That's in line with Lord Eosphorus' ideals, isn't it?

spans.text: Yes, of course. That's in line with Lord Eosphorus' ideals, isn't it?

units.rawText: That's why since Lord Eosphorus' return, he has repeatedly emphasized the importance of using force only in moderation. Lord Eosphorus is right, of course.
units.displayText: That's why since Lord Eosphorus' return, he has repeatedly emphasized the importance of using force only in moderation. Lord Eosphorus is right, of course.

spans.text: That's why since Lord Eosphorus' return, he has repeatedly emphasized the importance of using force only in moderation. Lord Eosphorus is right, of course.

units.rawText: Alright, I need to go carry out my mission. See you later.
units.displayText: Alright, I need to go carry out my mission. See you later.

spans.text: Alright, I need to go carry out my mission. See you later.

units.rawText: "See you later"?
units.displayText: "See you later"?

spans.text: "See you later"?

units.rawText: It's okay if you don't know what it means. Think of it as an ordinary farewell.
units.displayText: It's okay if you don't know what it means. Think of it as an ordinary farewell.

spans.text: It's okay if you don't know what it means. Think of it as an ordinary farewell.

units.rawText: Faith nods and watches with Love as Wisdom straps on her sniper rifle and leaves the training course briskly.
units.displayText: Faith nods and watches with Love as Wisdom straps on her sniper rifle and leaves the training course briskly.

spans.text: Faith nods and watches with Love as Wisdom straps on her sniper rifle and leaves the training course briskly.

units.rawText: Her slender form blends into the light before vanishing completely from sight.
units.displayText: Her slender form blends into the light before vanishing completely from sight.

spans.text: Her slender form blends into the light before vanishing completely from sight.
